Plant Life Sticker Packs

This Plant Life Sticker Pack brings to mind the calming nature of plants. For me, there is something calming about plants. It doesn't matter if you are around them inside or out; they are peaceful, and as an artist, they are inspiring as well. I have assembled this ready-to-print pack of 8 stickers for your journals, planners, or anywhere else. It is all one image, but you have 8 color options. You can easily print them onto sticker or regular paper if you want to cut them out and use them. I am a regular paper person!

Because there is only one image, there is only one pdf page with all of the images on one page. If you only want to print one image, you can open the PDF in any app that edits pdfs (goodnotes, Pages, Word, etc.) and add white boxes to cover the images you do not want to print. This trick works on almost any pdf or file. These stickers can be used in Goodnotes or any other journaling apps that accept PNG images. Using them at too large of a size will result in blurriness or pixelating.

Download The Plant Life Stickers Pack Printable PDF Here

The download link above will open the file directly in Google Drive. You do not need an account to access the file. The link will take you directly to the downloadable PDF. If you are interested in individual images or a full-sheet printable image, sign up for the FREE Divergent Vault to get full access to all of the files.

As you can see here with my Mushroom Life printout, my printer doesn't always match the screen. The page in person looks more green than this photo, but not really the same green as the images. For your convenience, the printable PDF files contain a test print page that includes a measurement tool as well as a single sticker so that you can test your colors before printing the entire page. I always have issues with this when I download other files. I am hyper-conscious about how much ink I waste, so I don't like printing blind!

Happy Journaling!
Sarah G
